name: Cerebellum
summary: Latin for "little brain." Only 10% of brain volume but contains over half of all neurons. Refines movement, balance, and procedural memory.

facts.text: The cerebellum contains roughly 50 to 80 billion neurons — more than all other brain regions combined — despite being only 10% of brain volume.
Alcohol impairs the cerebellum early, which is why the first signs of intoxication are poor balance and coordination.

detailedDescription: The cerebellum does not initiate movement — it refines it. Three functional divisions: Vestibulocerebellum (balance and eye movements), Spinocerebellum (body and limb movements, posture), and Cerebrocerebellum (motor planning, cognitive functions). It also stores procedural memory — how to ride a bike, type, or play an instrument without conscious thought.
